## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; Industrials/Materials/Energy strength vs Technology/Financials weakness provides mixed confirmations. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — confirms a neutral, stock-selective market.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Materials lead: DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +18.65%) and other cyclical miners showing strength. Industrials strong: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%) and DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.01% | 1M: +24.85%). Energy/Real Estate also contributing: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +25.42%), EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology lagging overall with mixed leaders: MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -15.26%) and GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.63% | 1M: -6.30%). Financials weak: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -4.21%). Consumer Discretionary pressured: AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -17.20%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), AVGO RECOVERY (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.68%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%), EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%). Leadership concentrated: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.73% | 1M: -14.34%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -28.68%), GM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.50% | 1M: -3.72%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -21.51%), SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -6.33%). Weakness concentrated in large-cap software and select financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Top 1W momentum: AMAT (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), CAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), AVGO (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.68%), NVDA (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%), EQIX (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%). Note major divergence: multiple large caps (AVGO, ORCL, TSLA, UNH) show 1W/1M mismatches — tactical moves, not broad confirmations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed and effectively in CORRECTION for many names despite strong pockets: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.69% | 1M: +2.84%), while ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -23.22%) and MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -15.26%). Sector breadth: Technology negative; watch for leadership narrowing.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are mixed-to-weak with pockets of news-driven interest: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -4.21%) and SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -6.33%), while some insurers/asset managers carry positive sentiment. Sector breadth: Financials lagging; cyclical credit sensitivity remains a risk.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare showing resilience but with dispersion: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +14.85%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +11.57%), while LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -6.09%). Sector breadth: modestly positive; defensive characteristics intact.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor cyclical/value exposure given Industrials/Materials/Energy strength — e.g., CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +25.42%), DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +18.65%). Reduce exposure to large-cap software/cloud names showing trend exhaustion (MSFT BELOW TREND, ADBE BELOW TREND) and monitor tech reversals rather than re-allocating core risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%).  
BEARISH: AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -17.20%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -37.10%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -29.49%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Industrials (sector up 1W: +3.10%), Materials (1W: +4.50%), Energy (1W: +3.04%).  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.24%), Financials (1W: -1.03%), Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.69%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%) for follow-through above this week’s swing high to signal tech participation. Monitor AAPL TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +5.96%) holding monthly support to avoid deeper tech pullback. Track AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -17.20%) closing beneath recent lows as a broader discretionary risk trigger.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
PFE (+75): Pfizer news on shareholder returns and pipeline; PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +11.57%) — sentiment confirmed. BLK/PYPL listed in headlines but lacking dual-timeframe in this set; monitor for follow-through before acting.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
ORCL (-50): Oracle lawsuit headline vs ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -23.22%) — bearish news but price showing short-term accumulation (divergence). UNH (-50): Medicare/MA outlook headline and UNH POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +1.08% | 1M: -18.09%) — watch for earnings/guidance reaction. AAPL (-45): AI execution headline with AAPL TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +5.96%) — negative sentiment to monitor for momentum impact.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt.  
CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%) and NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%) are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: narrow leadership and multiple large-cap 1W/1M divergences (ORCL, AVGO, UNH, AMZN) amid mixed news sentiment — monitor for confirmed breadth restoration.
